title: Checkout fails with a 500 after the discount code step

messages.text: Checkout returns a 500 when a customer applies a discount code. It works without a code. Please find the cause and fix it.
I'll start by reproducing it and reading the discount step.

Found it. `applyDiscount` reads `code.percent` but expired codes come back from the database with `percent: null`, so the total becomes NaN and the payment call throws. Fixing it so expired codes are rejected with a clear message, and adding a test.
All 14 checkout tests pass, including the new one for an expired code. The customer now sees "This code has expired" instead of a server error.
Great. Does the same bug exist for gift cards?
Checked: gift cards use a fixed amount, not a percent, so they cannot produce NaN. No change needed there.
